response:
Q3 Planning — Product / Engineering / Ops Sync

Meeting date: 2026-08-27

Key decisions / points

  • Q3 scope timing: Q3 scope must be finalized by Friday so Sara can take it to the executive review on Monday.
  • Reconciliation revamp: This was confirmed as the Q3 anchor initiative because the current reconciliation engine is failing on multi-currency batches, with three incidents this quarter and reconciliation support tickets up 40% QoQ.
  • Reconciliation approach: The team decided to build rather than buy. Vendor options were costly and still required meaningful integration work, while one option also failed tax-code requirements.
  • Reconciliation resourcing: Engineering estimates the rewrite at about six engineer-weeks, including FX rounding migration, with two weeks of help needed from Karim on ledger integration.
  • Mobile receipt capture: Design flows are complete and tested with six users. User feedback highlighted two needs: bulk-select before upload and a much more visible OCR confidence indicator.
  • Mobile v1 scope: Bulk-select will not be included in v1 because it would add about a sprint and the team is already capacity-constrained. It will be treated as a fast-follow roadmap item.
  • Vendor payout SLA goal: Finance wants payouts guaranteed within 48 hours of invoice approval. Current p95 is 71 hours.
  • Vendor payout bottlenecks: The main constraints are manual approval routing on the ops side and the ACH send-job batching window on the engineering side.
  • Potential payout fix: Ops believes a second west-coast approver plus reducing the ACH batching window from 12 hours to 4 hours could bring p95 to 48 hours by mid-Q3.
  • Payout decision still pending: Engineering flagged that the ACH change would increase daily ACH files and monitoring overhead. Leadership asked for a trade-off analysis and SRE input before committing.
  • Other roadmap changes: The audit-log retention update is officially pushed to Q4, aligned with Legal, and the internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern team unchanged.
  • Team health: HR raised concerns about bug-bash burnout in engineering, so Marcus will prepare a rotating on-call proposal by the end of the month.

Next steps / action items

  • Marcus: Confirm Karim’s availability with his manager this week for reconciliation support.
  • Marcus: Prepare an engineering proposal for a rotating on-call structure by August 31.
  • Marcus + Jenna: Complete the ACH batching-window trade-off analysis and bring it back next week.
  • SRE / leadership dependency: If SRE confirms the added monitoring load is manageable, proceed with the ACH batching change; otherwise consider an intermediate SLA target.
  • Dan: Update the mobile receipt-capture specs by Wednesday, reflecting the stronger OCR confidence indicator and the exclusion of bulk-select from v1.
  • Priya: Circulate the Q3 scope draft Thursday morning for review ahead of the Friday lock.
  • Sara: Take the finalized Q3 scope into the executive review on Monday.
